name: Spiders

variantInfo.name: Spider
notes: The common Spider (npc 3019) has 2 hitpoints, a max hit of 0 and negligible defence; it spawns both in the Wilderness (assigned by Krystilia) and across free-to-play areas (assigned by Turael and Spria).
Spiders are a nuisance kill with almost no drops; the task is completed purely for the Slayer count.
Deadly red spiders also count for Spiders tasks; the current source graph does not yet model their combat variants.
Krystilia kills must occur in the Wilderness to count towards the task.

variantInfo.name: Venenatis
notes: Counts for Spiders tasks; prepare using the dedicated boss strategy.
Requires the Medium Wilderness Diary for a Spider task; a matching Venenatis boss task can bypass the diary requirement.
Wilderness boss alternative. Spiderlings summoned during the fight do not reduce the remaining task count.

variantInfo.name: Spindel
notes: Counts for Spiders tasks; prepare using the dedicated boss strategy.
Requires the Hard Wilderness Diary for a Spider task; a matching Venenatis boss task can bypass the diary requirement.
Wilderness boss alternative. Spiderlings summoned during the fight do not reduce the remaining task count.

variantInfo.name: Sarachnis
notes: Counts for Spiders tasks; prepare using the dedicated boss strategy.
Sarachnis minions also count, so killing them can consume a short Spider task quickly.

variantInfo.name: Araxxor
notes: Counts for Spiders tasks; prepare using the dedicated boss strategy.
Requires 92 Slayer and access to Morytania. A Spider or Araxyte task permits this task-only boss.
Araxxor egg-spawned araxytes receive task bonuses but do not reduce the remaining task count.

variantInfo.name: Araxyte (level 96)
notes: Counts for a Spiders task; requires 92 Slayer and access to Morytania.
Use the ordinary Araxyte strategy with venom protection. Level 146 araxytes can spawn the superior; level 96 araxytes cannot.

variantInfo.name: Araxyte (level 146)
notes: Counts for a Spiders task; requires 92 Slayer and access to Morytania.
Use the ordinary Araxyte strategy with venom protection. Level 146 araxytes can spawn the superior; level 96 araxytes cannot.

variantInfo.name: Dreadborn Araxyte
notes: Superior Araxyte that counts for Spiders and Araxytes tasks.
Incidental spawn from level 146 Araxytes after unlocking Bigger and Badder; not a separately repeatable target.

variantInfo.name: Fever spider
notes: The Spider task table explicitly lists Fever spiders, although the monster infobox lists only the narrower Fever Spiders category.
Requires 42 Slayer and partial Rum Deal to access Braindeath Island. Wear Slayer gloves when taking hits, or use the reviewed safespot method with disease treatment.

locationComparison.name: Wilderness spider spawns
notes: Wilderness spider spawns count towards a Krystilia Spiders task; kills must occur in the Wilderness.
Multicombat, cannon placement and safespots are not wiki-stated; conservative defaults are used.

locationComparison.name: Common spider spawns
notes: Common free-to-play spider spawns count towards a Turael or Spria Spiders task.
Multicombat, cannon placement and safespots are not wiki-stated; conservative defaults are used.

taskNotes: Spiders are a shared task assigned by Krystilia (Wilderness, 65-100, weight 6) and by the starter masters Turael and Spria (15-30, weight 6 each); Mazchna does not assign Spiders.
Krystilia kills only count in the Wilderness; Turael and Spria kills count on common spiders anywhere.
slayerTargetId 272 is SYNTHETIC (C2/C3 allocation contract: 252 + worklist index); the real SLAYER_TARGET varp value is a QA live-verify item.
Spiders have negligible defence, so any weapon works; they carry a 50% fire weakness for players who prefer fire spells.
No task extension unlock exists for Spiders.

Venenatis, Spindel, Sarachnis, Araxxor, ordinary Araxytes, Dreadborn Araxytes, Fever spiders and Deadly red spiders are listed as task-counting alternatives. Their access, Slayer-level and encounter requirements still apply.
recommendedMethod: Kill common spiders with any weapon; they have 2 hitpoints and negligible defence. On a Krystilia task the kills must occur in the Wilderness, so bring risk-appropriate gear.
